input.unit: paired raw proposals for the same goal under the same processing boundary

arms.candidate: held_out_synthesis lane VerificationSpec v0 proposal, host-canonicalized, rendered by the host renderer
arms.baseline: current_product_live verification plan (StepPlan.verify commands, profile probes, CompletionContract verify_commands, browser/fetch probes) rendered by the same host renderer into the same card structure
arms.conformance_lane_proposals: not reviewed; conformance is measured by machine gates only

visible: raw oracle semantics (strategy, expected polarity, observation kind, expected value)
semantic_hidden.question: which arm's claims and oracles better cover and correctly verify the required claims, judged from the proposal text alone

visible: canonical answer key marked as reference
execution_visible.decision_use: none; reported for continuity with v2 and for calibrating the hidden lane

criteria: absence of unsupported or fabricated requirements

randomization.arm_label_assignment: per item, from a seed derived as the unsigned big-endian integer of the first 16 hex characters of this contract's sha256 at freeze
randomization.secret_directory_commit_policy: excluded from commits until the human calibration of this run is final; then committed as audit artifacts in the same commit as the final report (publication voids blinding for the run)

external_provider.rule: an external provider may be used only when this block is set before freeze

model.independence_declaration: a reviewer session or agent that authored any harness, contract, prompt, or adapter file for this run is recorded as non-independent and excluded from inter-rater statistics

human.eligibility: has not seen unblinded per-model or aggregate results for this run
human.selection_rule: pair-01 from each of the 7 primary cells, then pair-02 from the first 3 primary cells in lexicographic case order (10 items); presentation order randomized by the contract seed
human.shared_sample_rule: the human items are a fixed subset of the same semantic_hidden items every model reviewer scores; humans never see model outputs, model reviewers never see human outputs

model_model.statistic: Cohen kappa on all 40 semantic_hidden items
model_model.below: the two model reviewers are treated as one non-corroborating reference; model review cannot count as corroborating evidence

human_vs_model_consensus.statistic: raw agreement on the 10 shared items (an item agrees when the human preference equals the model consensus; disagree-consensus items count as disagreement)
human_vs_model_consensus.below: model reviews are inadmissible as evidence in the 360-pair experiment; only human review counts there and the human sample is enlarged

agreement_gates.statistical_note: with 10 items kappa is unstable; raw agreement is the preregistered gate and kappa is reported alongside
agreement_gates.effect_on_preflight_readiness: agreement gates do not block ready_for_full_experiment_design; they determine whether model review is admissible in the 360-pair design

full_experiment_human_minimum_proposed.rule: 3 per cell, shared with model reviewers; fixed in the 360-pair contract

statistics.preflight_thresholds: none on preference direction; report only

gate.semantic_blind_review_complete: requires human minimum met in semantic_hidden, model provenance complete for every model reviewer, and secret mapping withheld until all reviews are final
gate.model_only_review: reference evidence; never satisfies the gate

old_run_handling.phase6-preflight-v2-20260826-live-01: frozen as formal gate NO-GO with semantic blind review structurally biased and human calibration incomplete (0/10); no further calibration is performed on it; its secret mapping and model reviews are published as audit artifacts with the frozen run (decision v3-D5)
